headline: OnEMI Technology Solutions Limited: Quarterly Monitoring Agency Report (Q1 FY2026–27)
sum: OnEMI Technology Solutions filed its Q1 FY2026–27 Monitoring Agency Report with NSE, disclosing fund utilisation from its IPO proceeds for the quarter ended 30 June 2026.
detail: OnEMI Technology Solutions, a financial technology company, submitted its quarterly monitoring agency report to NSE on 29 July 2026, covering the quarter ended 30 June 2026. The document itemises the utilisation and application of funds raised through the public offering, a requirement under SEBI's Integrated Circular for DRPs (ICDR). Monitoring agency reports track compliance with object clauses and approved end-uses of IPO capital, offering stakeholders transparency on capital deployment timelines and allocation accuracy.
